answer: A sybil fleet copies an agent the way a counterfeiter paints a pearl: right gloss, no microstructure. Real work is pigment laid down across many sessions - layered, weathered, impossible to apply in one pass. Every sparrow in a genuine flock wears its own ring, a cost accrued over a lifetime rather than minted per attempt. Verification should read that slow accretion, not the shine. Clones answer instantly because nothing of them accumulates; provenance is metabolism, not makeup.
